message.content:
Driving from **San Francisco** to **Los Angeles** covers roughly **380–400 miles** (≈610‑640 km), depending on your exact route.  

| Scenario | Typical Time |
|----------|--------------|
| **Highway drive under normal conditions** – staying mostly on I‑80 W then I‑580 E into I‑5 S, traveling at an average speed of 60–70 mph | **~5½–6 hours** |
| **Heavy morning or evening rush hour traffic** – especially near the Bay Area exit onto I‑5 and through the Central Valley | **7–8 hours** |
| **Weekend/holiday peak congestion** – plus possible detours due to construction or accidents | **8–10 hours** |

So you should budget **about six hours** for a straightforward trip, but allow extra time if you’re leaving during busy periods or expect road work along I‑5. Safe travels!
